sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
notLoggedInOpenPopup: Not signed in. Open the TimeTrack popup and sign in.

api.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
api.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again

auth.tokenValidationStatus: Token validation failed: the server responded {status}

url.notAllowed: Use timetrack.dk, app.timetrack.dk, beta.timetrack.dk or localhost
url.invalid: Use a valid HTTPS address without a path or username

entry.hoursPositive: Enter a number of hours greater than 0
entry.timesCannotBeRemoved: The times cannot be removed. Edit start and end instead
entry.fillStartEnd: Fill in both start and end
entry.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time

timer.stopFailed: Could not stop the timer. Try again
timer.stopNetwork: Could not stop the timer: network error
timer.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the timer. Try again
timer.cancelNetwork: Could not cancel the timer: network error
timer.cancelStoppingElsewhere: The timer is already being stopped from {source}
timer.addTimeFailed: Could not add time to the timer
timer.offlineStop: You are offline. Stop the timer again when the connection is back
timer.stopInProgress: A stop is in progress{elsewhere}. Try again in a moment. If it hangs, the time is parked as paused after a few minutes so it is not lost.
timer.alreadyRunning: A timer is already running{elsewhere}. Stop or cancel it first if you want to start a new one.
timer.alreadyPaused: There is already a paused timer with time on it{elsewhere}. Stop or cancel it first if you want to start a new one.
timer.stopAlreadyInProgress: A stop is already in progress from {source}. Check your time overview in a moment
timer.prepaidPinnedUnavailable: The selected prepaid package could not be used, so the time was saved without a package deduction
timer.prepaidLookupFailed: The prepaid package could not be looked up, so the time was saved without a package deduction
timer.prepaidDeductionFailed: The package deduction failed, so the time was saved without a deduction from the package
timer.sessionMismatch: The timer was changed from another browser or device. Here is the current one.
timer.beingStopped: The timer is being stopped from another browser or device.
timer.startRejectedPaused: There is already a paused timer with time on it. Stop or cancel it first if you want to start a new one.
timer.startRejectedStale: The timer was just stopped somewhere else. Try starting again.
timer.startRejectedRunning: A timer is already running from another browser or device. Stop it first if you want to start a new one.

clientTooOld: Update the TimeTrack extension. This version cannot save time

server.noPermission: The extension has no access to this server
server.changedRetry: The server has changed. Try again
server.changedLoginAgain: The server has changed. Sign in again
server.loginOnSelected: Sign in to the selected server again
server.grantAccess: Allow the extension to access the server to connect
server.syncPendingFirst: Synchronise pending entries before you switch server
server.useSelector: Use the server selector to switch server
server.invalidFormat: Enter a valid server address, for example https://time.example.com
server.httpsRequired: The server address must use HTTPS
server.noPathOrCredentials: Use only the server address, without username, path or parameters
server.notTimeTrack: This is not a TimeTrack server
server.tooOld: The server is too old for this app (requires API ≥ {version})
server.appTooOld: This app is too old for the server. Update the app
server.unreachableCheck: Cannot reach the server. Check the address and the certificate
server.unreachableLater: Cannot reach the server. Try again later
